verify.note: Closed 2026-09-29 (ADR-1637). Five real sources pass unchanged and eight hostile values return null. Every non-null return is `if (RE.test(v)) return v`, each RE anchored at both ends with no bare dot, negated class or \S/\W/\D.

append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1637). RE-TESTED first: the probe failed on this tree on blob:https://app.local/">, which came back verbatim from URL#toString(). SHIPPED. safeImageSrc trims, then returns only from if (IMAGE_PATH.test(s)) return s (and the data, http(s), blob siblings). IMAGE_PATH is a leading slash whose next character is not a slash. IMAGE_DATA is data:image/png|jpeg|jpg|gif|webp|avif;base64 plus a base64 body (inline SVG is out). IMAGE_HTTP is host plus an explicit path/query class with no credentials, quotes, angle brackets, backticks, spaces or backslashes. IMAGE_BLOB is blob:http(s)://host/. Tests cover the hostile set. safeUploadPreviewSrc still refuses data: and paths, and now shares the blob and http literals. Fix, never dismiss. Other CodeQL alerts remain HYG-143.
